stories.headline: Trump makes personnel moves as he enters presidency
stories.summary: Donald Trump reaches his 80th birthday amid broader questions about cognitive and physical demands of high-level work at advanced age. His milestone reflects a wider conversation about aging leaders and workplace performance that extends beyond his candidacy.

angles.headline: As Trump turns 80, what's it really like to work as an octogenarian?
angles.summary: Donald Trump reaches his 80th birthday amid broader questions about cognitive and physical demands of high-level work at advanced age. His milestone reflects a wider conversation about aging leaders and workplace performance that extends beyond his candidacy.

angles.headline: Trump to name James McDonald – one of his lawyers – as Wall Street’s top cop
angles.summary: Trump selects James McDonald, a lawyer from his legal team, to lead the Securities and Exchange Commission, the primary federal regulator overseeing Wall Street and financial markets. This appointment continues a pattern of Trump placing personal attorneys in prominent government positions that typically operate with significant independence from the executive branch.

angles.headline: Trump’s name is gone from the Kennedy Center’s facade: top official
angles.summary: The Kennedy Center has removed Donald Trump's name from its building facade, according to a senior official at the arts institution. The decision reflects shifts in how the venue presents itself following Trump's presidency and the events surrounding January 6th.

stories.headline: Trump says US-Iran deal to be signed on Sunday as Tehran casts doubt on timing
stories.summary: Trump announces plans to sign a US-Iran agreement on Sunday, though Iranian officials express skepticism about the proposed timeline and the deal remains absent from his official schedule. The announcement comes as Israel conducts military operations in Beirut and accuses Hezbollah of breaching ceasefire terms, adding regional complexity to diplomatic efforts.

stories.headline: Royal Marines board Russian shadow fleet oil tanker in English Channel
stories.summary: Royal Marines boarded a Russian shadow fleet oil tanker operating in the English Channel, seizing a vessel suspected of evading international sanctions through obscured ownership structures. The interception represents Britain's enforcement of sanctions against Russia's covert maritime operations that circumvent restrictions on oil exports.

stories.headline: New York Knicks win NBA championship for first time in over 50 years
stories.summary: The New York Knicks capture their first NBA championship since 1970, ending a 53-year drought that spans generations of fans. Guard Jalen Brunson leads the team to victory against the San Antonio Spurs, delivering a championship to a city that has waited more than half a century for this moment.

stories.headline: Why Haiti v Scotland was antidote to the ills of world football
stories.summary: Scotland defeated Haiti 1-0 in a World Cup match, securing the team's first tournament victory in 36 years. The match drew praise for delivering compelling, straightforward competition that contrasted with the complexity and controversy that often define modern international football.

stories.headline: Swiss voters reject 10 million population cap, early projections say
stories.summary: Swiss voters reject a proposal that would have capped the country's population at 10 million, according to early projections from Sunday's referendum. The measure, backed by the right-wing Swiss People's Party, sought to limit immigration and was expected to conflict with Switzerland's bilateral agreements with the European Union.

stories.headline: 2026 World Cup: Australia stun Turkiye 2-0 in counterattacking masterclass
stories.summary: Australia defeats Turkiye 2-0 in a World Cup match by exploiting spaces left by an attacking opponent, with goals from strikes that catch the Turkiye defense unprepared. The victory demonstrates Australia's ability to execute a disciplined tactical approach against a higher-ranked side in a tournament setting.

stories.headline: Deadly Philippines earthquake found to have raised seabed by up to 2 metres
stories.summary: A recent earthquake in the Philippines lifted portions of the seabed up to 2 metres higher, fundamentally altering the underwater topography in the affected region. This sudden geological shift has disrupted marine ecosystems and contributed to significant loss of sea life in the area.

stories.headline: Ukrainian drone strikes kill one, spark fire at oil facility in Russia
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones have struck a Russian oil facility, resulting in one death and igniting a fire at the site. The attack appears part of an ongoing campaign by Kyiv to target Russian energy infrastructure and supply lines supporting military operations.

stories.headline: Romanian president picks Liberal former mayor as PM to form new government
stories.summary: Romania's president has selected a Liberal Party former mayor to serve as prime minister and lead efforts to form a new government. The appointment follows political developments that created a vacancy in the office and reflects the president's choice to work with the Liberal Party in rebuilding the executive branch.
